questions.subject: Japanese
questions.prompt: What is the Japanese word for the number 17?

block.label: Scrub It
block.sub: Rub out the wrong answers with your finger

questions.why: Juunana (juu + nana, '10 + 7') means 17; juuroku is 16, juuhachi is 18, and nanajuu means 70, not 17.
